title: AIstatLab at BraTS-GoAT 2026 Task 3: Quality-Controlled Consensus Pseudo-Labeling and Dense Expert Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: BraTS-GoAT Task 3 evaluates brain-tumor segmentation across heterogeneous entities using shared ET, TC, and WT regions. We present a 3D ResidualEncoderUNet trained with quality-controlled consensus pseudo-labels, a training-only nested-region objective, and a four-expert bottleneck adapter. Five-fold ResEnc-M/L teachers gener ated predictions for 1,138 unlabeled cases; fusion, hierarchy enforcement, and confidence-and-agreement screening retained 983 for training with 1,351 annotated cases. The final five-fold ResEnc-M entry achieved mean DSC 0.834, mean NSD 0.510, and Acalc = 0.6720 on the validation server. Component effects were modest and region-dependent, with the clearest gains on ET. Source code is available at https://github.com/HeeSeung-Shin/Brats2026-Goat-HS.

translated_title: AIstatLab 参加 BraTS-GoAT 2026 任务三：质量控制共识伪标签与稠密专家适配
translated_abstract: BraTS-GoAT 任务三使用共享的ET（增强肿瘤）、TC（肿瘤核心）和WT（整体肿瘤）区域，对异质性实体进行脑肿瘤分割评估。我们提出了一种3D ResidualEncoderUNet，其训练采用质量控制共识伪标签、仅用于训练阶段的嵌套区域目标函数以及四专家瓶颈适配器。五折ResEnc-M/L教师模型为1,138个未标注病例生成预测；经过融合、层级约束以及置信度与一致性筛选后，保留了983个病例用于与1,351个标注病例共同训练。最终的五折ResEnc-M模型在验证服务器上取得了平均DSC 0.834、平均NSD 0.510以及Acalc = 0.6720的成绩。各组件的效果较为温和且依赖于区域，其中在ET（增强肿瘤）上的提升最为明显。源代码可在 https://github.com/HeeSeung-Shin/Brats2026-Goat-HS 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合质量控制共识伪标签与四专家瓶颈适配器的3D ResidualEncoderUNet，用于BraTS-GoAT 2026脑肿瘤分割任务，在验证服务器上取得平均DSC 0.834的成绩。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a 3D ResidualEncoderUNet combining quality-controlled consensus pseudo-labeling and a four-expert bottleneck adapter for brain tumor segmentation in BraTS-GoAT 2026 Task 3, achieving a mean DSC of 0.834 on the validation server.
